The '''74th Imperial Garrison''' was a military unit deployed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Sometime prior to the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Garrison/Legends|Garrison]] was subject to a [[Raid on the 74th Imperial Garrison|raid]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which resulted in the theft of several pre-fab buildings.<ref name="OAA1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 74th Imperial Garrison was mentioned in ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'', [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] adventure.<ref name="OAA1" />
